name: shadcn-places-example
description: A bare consumer project. Proves the registry item actually installs and compiles.

scripts.setup: cd .. && bun link && cd example && bun link shadcn-places && bun install
scripts.install-picker: bunx --bun shadcn@latest add ${PLACES_URL:-https://shadcn-places.gedw99.workers.dev}/r/places-picker.json && bunx --bun shadcn@latest add ${PLACES_URL:-https://shadcn-places.gedw99.workers.dev}/r/places-coverage.json
